grammar_contract.input: An ordinary parse-that child state at a source-native UTF-16 offset corresponding to one retained CSS-preprocessed position or EOF, with any predecessor value and any valid parse-that diagnostic state.
grammar_contract.operation: Inspect no more than the next three positions through direct parse-that terminals/combinators. Return true exactly for digit, sign+digit, dot+digit, or sign+dot+digit; otherwise false.
grammar_contract.composition: The public harness invokes the candidate as string(prefix).map(variedPredecessor).next(candidate).skip(string(continuation)); .next invokes the candidate raw child parser.
grammar_contract.state_identity: Return the same ParserState object received by the child.
grammar_contract.consumption: Always succeed, replace the predecessor with one boolean, consume zero code units, and leave the following grammar at the candidate offset.
grammar_contract.diagnostics: Under explicit package diagnostics-disabled and diagnostics-enabled modes, preserve furthest, expected own-property presence, expected array identity and ordered values, suggestions array identity and each entry identity/fields, and secondarySpans array identity and each entry identity/fields. Preserve the global diagnostics mode.
diagnostic_profiles: undefined expected with multiple diagnostics before
grammar_contract.diagnostic_sandbox: Recognition uses direct core combinators. A candidate-local Parser wrapper may snapshot and restore only diagnostic bookkeeping around speculative recognition. It may not import the diagnostics subpath, change global mode, inspect/slice state.src, classify source manually, advance a cursor, or feed a token/CST layer.
grammar_contract.preprocessing: ASCII +, -, ., and digits are unchanged by preprocessing. Raw and preprocessed truth is asserted only at explicitly mapped corresponding retained positions/EOF. CRLF's eliminated LF interior is excluded and must never be supplied by the future source-map dependency.
grammar_contract.work_bound: Worst-case O(1) time and space; inspect no more than three positions; no whole-number/exponent run, substring/CST/token materialization, imperative loop, or scanner.
